nrIncident.summary: Lines reopened: disruption between London St Pancras International and London Blackfriars expected until 02:00
nrIncident.routes: Between Peterborough and Horsham, between Cambridge and Brighton, between Welwyn Garden City and Sevenoaks, between Finsbury Park and Sevenoaks, between Bedford and East Grinstead / Gatwick Airport / Three Bridges / Brighton, between Luton and Rainham (Kent), between St Albans City and Sutton (surrey), and also between West Hampstead Thameslink / Kentish Town and Orpington
nrIncident.message:
Lines have reopened following a number of incidents between London St Pancras International and London Blackfriars. Whilst service recovers, trains operating between these stations may be cancelled, delayed by up to 20 minutes or revised.
This is expected until 02:00.
Customer advice:
You may need to change trains to complete your journey and allow at least 60 minutes extra time to travel.
Services will be reinstated where possible, however, there are still changes or cancellations across the network. Please check journey planners before you travel as your train may be cancelled.
These incidents are not expected to affect services in the morning, but but please continue to check your journey before you travel.
How the service is being affected:
• Some trains that normally run between Bedford and Three Bridges have been reinstated but some trains may still be cancelled
• Trains that normally run between Cambridge and London Kings Cross will stop additionally at Ashwell & Morden in both directions
• Trains that normally run between Cambridge and London Kings Cross will stop additionally at Ashwell & Morden and Stevenage in both directions
Tickets are being accepted at no extra cost on:
• Alternative Great Northern services between London Kings Cross and Cambridge
• Alternative Southern services between London Victoria, Sutton and Brighton
• London Underground services between London Terminals
• London Buses:
• between Sutton, Wimbledon and East Croydon
• London and Dartford
If you are travelling between London and Cambridge:
A reduced Thameslink service continues to run between London St Pancras International and Stevenage. You can either change there for a Great Northern service towards Cambridge, or use a Great Northern service directly from London Kings Cross, which is about a 5 minute distance from London St Pancras International.
If you are travelling between London and Bedford:
Services between London St Pancras International and Bedford may still be cancelled or delayed by at least 40 minutes.
Planning your journey:
For help planning your journey, check live departure boards, view a live network map or see alternative route guides.
If you’re travelling within London, you can use the TfL Journey Planner.
Stay up to date on the move with Thameslink's WhatsApp channel. Live updates are available Monday to Friday, 07:00–21:00.
Can you tell me more about the incident?
A number of incidents were affecting train services between London St Pancras International and London Blackfriars:
• A fault with the signalling system in the City Thameslink area
• A points failure at London Blackfriars
Network Rail signalling specialists have investigated these faults and repaired the affected equipment. Trains can now run at normal speeds, however it will take some time for the scheduled timetable to be recovered as drivers and trains have become displaced by the disruption.

You can check your journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner.
Compensation:
